name: B10-0454/2026 (S&D) – The cases of Ali Karimli, Anar Mammadli and other political prisoners in Azerbaijan
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the cases of Ali Karimli, Anar Mammadli and other political prisoners in Azerbaijan
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and making requests. It condemns the detention of Ali Karimli and Anar Mammadli and other political prisoners in Azerbaijan, and calls for their release. It asks Azerbaijan to change its laws on non-governmental organisations and media. It asks the European Union to consider sanctions on Azerbaijani officials and to make any partnership deal, including on energy, depend on respect for rights.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament only asks for releases, law changes, sanctions and a suspended energy deal.
- **Who it affects:** Azerbaijan's government, detained activists and journalists, and European Union governments and the Commission.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to European Union bodies and to Azerbaijan's president, government and parliament.
